mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions(text, amount, category_id, date, user_id, type, note, image_url) VALUES(#{text}, #{amount}, #{categoryId}, #{date}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{note}, #{imageUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'INCOME' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as totalIncome, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'EXPENSE' THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) as totalExpense FROM transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT c.name as name, SUM(ABS(t.amount)) as value FROM transactions t INNER JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.type = #{type} GROUP BY c.name

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-%d') DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m') DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y') DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-%d') as timeLabel, SUM(ABS(amount)) as total FROM transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = #{type} GROUP BY timeLabel ORDER BY timeLabel ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE transactions SET text = #{text}, amount = #{amount}, category_id = #{categoryId}, date = #{date}, note = #{note}, image_url = #{imageUrl} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(t.date) as date, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'INCOME' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) as income, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'EXPENSE' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) as expense FROM transactions t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(t.date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'INCOME' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as income, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'EXPENSE' THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) as expense, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'INCOME' THEN amount ELSE ABS(amount) * -1 END) as net FROM transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m') = #{month}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m') as month, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'INCOME' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as income, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as expense, COUNT(*) as transactionCount FROM transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month DESC

SELECT t.text, t.amount, t.date, c.name as categoryName FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.type = 'EXPENSE' AND t.date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) ORDER BY t.amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM transactions WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, c.name as categoryName FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.user_id = #{userId}
